explanation.text: The Logic: Rematerialisation is the issuance of physical securities in place of securities held electronically. The depository account of the client is debited, and the issuer/RTA arranges dispatch of the physical certificates to the client. The Trap: Converting physical certificates to electronic form is dematerialisation — the reverse process. Inter-depository transfers and pledging are unrelated workflows. Note: The remat process described here is grounded in the depository operations workbook's rematerialisation section; cross-references to other series should not be inferred beyond what the source states.
